papers.title: Manifold-GS: Certified Hybrid Assets via Varifold-Conservative Gaussian Splatting
papers.representation: 3DGS + discrete unoriented varifold + certified open surface patches + residual splats
papers.outputs: certified hybrid asset with open patches/residual splats
papers.central_contribution: Separates appearance opacity from geometric quadrature mass, uses refinement-conservative varifold mass transport, local realizability diagnostics, source-preserving patch bindings and conservative collision candidates.
papers.major_algorithms: varifold-conservative quadrature; patch certification; source bindings
papers.metrics: patch-defined edit leakage; texture round-trip PSNR; collision floater area; precision/coverage
papers.limitations: Precision-coverage tradeoff; local realizability is not sufficient for sparse-view identifiability.
papers.claims_relevant_to_maveb: Major collision for any broad 'certified Gaussian asset/editing' or refinement-stable geometric representation claim.
papers.overlap_with_candidate_maveb_contributio: Thematic high; mathematical guarantee differs from H010. Manifold-GS certifies extracted hybrid surface assets and source bindings under refinement, whereas H010 currently bounds additive Gaussian density-field disturbance outside an arbitrary edit volume.
papers.potential_unexplored_gap: Uniform analytic non-target field/render disturbance bounds for arbitrary Gaussian edits; must prove this is not implicit in Manifold-GS and must compare directly.

papers.title: FocusGS: Spatial Delta Layers for Local Repair and Deterministic Editing of Trained 3D Gaussian Assets

papers.central_contribution: Unifies additive repair and erase-insert deterministic editing through spatial delta layers while freezing global asset and suppressing non-target bleed.
papers.major_algorithms: composite spatial delta; erase-insert factorization; local Gaussian optimization; protected-region penalties
papers.metrics: target ROI PSNR; target-mask PSNR; target-delta correlation; local repair gains
papers.runtime: minutes-scale local optimization per secondary summary
papers.limitations: Retrieved sources do not establish a formal uniform non-target disturbance bound.
papers.claims_relevant_to_maveb: Kills novelty of deterministic spatial-delta maintenance/local repair/editing framing.
papers.overlap_with_candidate_maveb_contributio: Very high for local-maintenance system framing; lower for H010 analytic certificate if materially distinct.
papers.potential_unexplored_gap: A provable outside-region disturbance certificate layered onto deterministic editing rather than another spatial-delta operator.
